basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. I recently developed an interest in vinyl records after inheriting a collection from my grandfather. Outside of work, I love exploring local flea markets and record shops. I usually browse Reddit during my lunch break and late evenings. I'm single and enjoy the casual conversations and humor I find here.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in visual arts and a keen interest in design and media. My knowledge about vinyl records is very basic and mostly self-taught through online resources and community discussions.
